$comment: FIT-01 job.onduty writer registry. This is an ownership registry, not a debt register: every entry is a writer the architecture allows. qb-core/server/player.lua is the primitive; custom-police/server/p0.lua is the service implementation; custom-main and custom-director may only keep their non-police branches. Expiry is null for those architectural owners. The scanner (tests/architecture/test_duty_writer.py) still validates every custom-main/custom-director occurrence is inside the non-police branch of a function that guards police and calls SetDutyForSource. qb-core/server/events.lua (QBCore:ToggleDuty) is framework vendor code and out of this scanner's scope because qb-core must not be modified; custom-police's OnJobUpdate projection covers it.

entries.reason: qb-core 的 SetJobDuty 是 job.onduty 唯一底层 primitive，保留不动；所有业务写者必须经 custom-police 的 duty 服务调用它。
唯一警察 duty 服务 P.SetDutyForSource 的实现：校验 police、pcall(SetJobDuty)、回读 PlayerData.job.onduty、syncDuty 投影、审计 duty.set。该文件内只允许这一处 SetJobDuty 调用。
FIT-01 allowlist：仅非 leo / ambulance/mechanic/taxi 的 /duty 与通缉锁保留 qb-core SetJobDuty；jobName == 'police' 分支必须先走 exports['custom-police']:SetDutyForSource。
FIT-01 allowlist：仅非 leo / ambulance/mechanic/taxi 的 set_job_duty 目标保留 qb-core SetJobDuty；currentJob.type == 'leo' 或 name == 'police' 分支必须先走 custom-police:SetDutyForSource。
